content.comment_body: Is there any performance or design benefit when choosing between the 12VDC or 24VDC versions of the [product_name] models? I'm working on a new project that requires analog inputs, and my options are 12VDC or 24VDC. I'll be getting a new power supply either way to fit the [product_name]. Also, are the [product_name] power supplies recommended, and if so, for what reasons? Thanks, [user_name]

Hello, The choice of power supply mainly depends on your specific requirements. In industrial automation, 24VDC is typically the standard option, whereas in automotive settings 12VDC is more common (except for trucks, which often use 24VDC) and some solar projects. If there aren’t any functional differences between them, you can select whichever suits your preference. Regarding [product_name] Power, it is a standard power supply and can be used inside installation cabinets for residential buildings (as it shares the same housing as the [product_name]). Still, there are many different power supply options available from other vendors with varying designs and housings. Hope this clarifies things.
